Description

* Large sized Meeting Room

The Harris Institute of Teaching and Leadership in Beckenham offers its large-sized meeting room for private hire, providing a versatile venue for a wide range of events.

Located within a modern educational facility, the meeting room is available for evening hire on weekdays and all day on weekends, offering flexibility for your event planning. Block bookings are also welcome, providing a convenient option for recurring events or extended engagements. With its professional setting and complimentary Wi-Fi, the meeting room is an ideal space for conferences, meetings, training sessions, and other business-related events. It also suits community events like workshops, classes, and group activities.

The Harris Institute of Teaching and Leadership provides a professional and well-maintained environment for your next event.
